extName.description: Store listing name and toolbar tooltip fallback. 75 characters max.

extDescription.message: Capture a whole web page as one image or PDF. Scrolls and stitches for you. Nothing leaves your browser.
extDescription.description: Store summary. Plain text, 132 characters max.

popupCapturing.description: Progress line in the popup. $PCT$ is a number from 0 to 100.

popupHint.message: You can close this popup. The capture continues and opens when it is done.

popupBusy.message: Another capture is still running. Try again when it finishes.

errRestricted.message: Chrome does not allow extensions to capture this page.

errFailed.description: $DETAIL$ is a technical error message in English.

errNoTab.message: The tab was closed before the capture finished.

errTabSwitched.message: The capture stopped because you switched to another tab. Stay on the page until it finishes.

viewerEmpty.message: No captures yet. Click the Pagesmith button on any page to make one.

viewerNotFound.message: This capture no longer exists. Older captures are deleted automatically.

viewerCopyMulti.message: This capture is split into several images, so it cannot be copied as one. Download it instead.

viewerParts.message: The page is taller than Chrome can encode as one image, so it downloads as $COUNT$ images. The PDF contains all of them.
viewerParts.description: $COUNT$ is the number of image files.

viewerPartialVisible.message: Chrome does not allow scrolling this page, so only the visible area was captured.

viewerPartialLimit.message: The page is taller than the maximum height set in Options, so the capture stops there.

optPreScroll.message: Scroll through the page first so lazy-loaded images appear

optShortcutHelp.message: Change it in Chrome's extension shortcut settings.

optPrivacy.message: Captures are stored only in this browser. Pagesmith makes no network requests.
